name: @kojo/plugin-ui-market
description: Market panel (ui.panel contribution): browse the local registry list grouped by pack kind with a name/author filter, list installed packs, uninstall behind one inline confirmation, and state explicitly when the list file is missing / unreadable / broken / empty. No install button in this batch - the Rust unpack primitive has not landed, so remote installs have no capability yet. Consumes the market service via requires + ctx.inject; never imports the market plugin. Contains zero game knowledge.
